BiblicalUsage: This is the work of beating something to powder, fine as dust. The holy incense was beaten very small before it was set before the testimony, and David beat his enemies small as the dust of the earth and cast them out as dirt in the streets.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God grinds His enemies to dust and His incense to powder, and both are done thoroughly.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
